title: trifolium arvense var. littorale
intro: Trifolium arvense var. littorale, commonly known as Red Clover, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing the risk of heart disease and menopausal symptoms, as well as alleviating osteoporosis. The therapeutic actions of Red Clover are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic agent, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote bone health. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover include isoflavones, particularly genistein and daidzein, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
